# China Robotics Insider

> China Robotics Insider is an independent English-language publication covering China's robotics industry — founders, companies, products, development history and the supply chain behind the world's largest humanoid ecosystem.

> Site: https://www.robotichina.com
> Key topics: humanoid robots, robot supply chain, actuators, reducers, sensors, LiDAR, clean room robots, educational robots, robot vacuums, industrial robots
## Database

- [XPENG's IRON Walks Off China's First Automated Humanoid Line](https://www.robotichina.com/xpeng-iron-production-line.html): world's first automated humanoid production line; IRON 178cm/70kg/76+42 DOF/2,250 TOPS; >80% core automation, 85% EV supply-chain overlap; volume by end-2026, overseas H2 2027.
- [China's Cloud Robotics: The $14B Bet That Robot Brains Belong in the Cloud](https://www.robotichina.com/china-cloud-robotics.html): global cloud robotics $14.2B (2026) to $92.1B (2035); China intelligent cloud robot market ¥412.6B; CloudMinds XR-4 (168cm, 60+ joints, 10kg arm) and Datta Robotics' ¥3B seed round; cloud-brain vs on-device AI.
- [Inovance Q3 2026 Earnings: Automation Hits +33%, but Profit and Cash Tell a Second Story](https://www.robotichina.com/inovance-q3-2026-earnings.html): 9M revenue ¥37.96B (+19.9%), net profit ¥4.40B (+3.4%), recurring flat ¥3.91B; general automation +33% to ¥15.9B (servo ¥6.9B / inverter ¥4.8B / PLC-HMI ¥1.9B) on AI data-center capex; NEV powertrain +8% to ¥15.5B; robots+digital energy +88% to ¥2.1B; gross margin 28.2% (-1.0pt), operating cash flow -77% to ¥0.9B, inventory +54%; Q3 recurring profit -5.4% despite headline +23.6% (¥419M investment fair-value gains); InoBot W1 wheeled embodied robot + AI welding agents; ex-NEV profit bars ¥4.9/5.7/6.8/8.3B for 2026-29.
- [Unitree H2-X "Kung Fu Legend Guardian": Backflips, a Car Lift, and No Price Tag](https://www.robotichina.com/unitree-h2-x-kung-fu-guardian.html): Oct 21 launch on the H2 platform — 182cm/70kg/31 DoF, 360 N·m leg torque, claimed ~8h endurance vs 3h on the base H2; demo shows car roll-over, 4m drop, kicks, knife-block; no price or order channel yet.
- [Unitree Q3 2026 Earnings: Revenue Accelerates to +70%, but Profit Dipped as R&D Triples for Foundation Models](https://www.robotichina.com/unitree-q3-earnings-preview.html): First post-IPO report (filed Oct 28): Q3 revenue ¥665M (+69.93%), net profit ¥113M (-17.37%), recurring ¥105M (-17.42%); R&D tripled to ¥127M (+249.6%, 19.1% of quarterly revenue) into embodied-AI foundation models and compute; 9M revenue ¥1.817B (+55.7%), net ¥387M (+270.5% flattered by prior-year one-off stock comp), recurring -18.8%; gross margin 50.6% Q3 / 54.0% 9M; contract liabilities +70% to ¥233M, inventory +177% to ¥1.02B; Wang Xingxing three priorities: scale production, on-hardware physical-AI small models, ultra-large compute cluster, "self-evolving V1.0" model; stock ¥695.9, market cap ~¥281.5B, Dongwu Buy PE ~510x 2026E.
- [AgiBot Innovation Day 2026: 20,000 Robots, ¥2B Half-Year Revenue, and a New Worken Metric for the Deployment Era](https://www.robotichina.com/agibot-innovation-day-2026.html): Innovation Day 2026 (Oct 29, Shanghai): company-disclosed 20,000 cumulative general AI robots (20,000th unit Sept), ~¥2B H1 2026 revenue, ~9,700 H1 shipments, claimed 43% global humanoid share; new Worken productivity metric = active robots x autonomous work hours x output efficiency ("Token measures thinking, Worken measures acting"); AHA3 integrated locomotion/interaction/task architecture with liquid-cooled IP67 joints; OmniHand 3 Lite/3/Ultra + OmniPicker 3; GO-3 Preview embodied foundation model on WRAM framework (reported RoboDojo/RoboTwin/RoboColiseum #1, open source by year-end); WITA-Omni 1.0 omni-modal interaction model (100+ languages, 29 dialects); Lingqu OS 1.0 open-source plan; G2 Max industrial robot (40 kg dual-arm); deployment shift: CAICT-linked data show many humanoids run <10 days/month, entertainment+data collection >60% of shipments, manufacturing 13%.
- [US-Listed China Robotics Stocks: XPEV, FFIE, HSAI and the 2026 Robot Stock Wave](https://www.robotichina.com/us-listed-china-robotics-stocks.html): direct US tickers for China robotics — XPeng (PX unit >$900M round, IRON line live), Faraday Future (9 robots Sep 19), Hesai (robot LiDAR #1); UBTECH OTC; Unitree A-share IPO halved 55%.
- [Unitree G1 vs Figure 02: China's $13.5K Robot vs America's $130K Bet](https://www.robotichina.com/unitree-g1-vs-figure-02.html): head-to-head of the world's most-shipped Chinese humanoid ($13.5K, open SDK, buyable) against America's flagship enterprise humanoid (est. $130K+, Helix AI, BMW-only) — specs, price, AI and strategy.
- [Unitree Go2 vs Spot: China's $1.6K Robot Dog vs America's $74.5K Standard](https://www.robotichina.com/unitree-go2-vs-spot.html): a 47x price gap between the world's best-selling robot dog ($1,600, open SDK, ROS2) and the industrial gold standard ($74,500, GraphNav/Autowalk/Orbit, 1,500+ enterprise deployments) — specs, software and who should buy what.
- [Chinese Robot Arms vs ABB & KUKA: China's 55% Share Takeover](https://www.robotichina.com/china-robot-arms-vs-abb-kuka.html): in Q1 2026 Chinese brands passed 55% of China's robot market for the first time — Estun, Inovance and JAKA against ABB, KUKA and Fanuc. Share crossing, 30-80% price gap, where Europe still leads (heavy payload, certification), and buyer guidance.
- [Unitree H2 vs Atlas: China's $29.9K vs America's $420K Humanoid](https://www.robotichina.com/unitree-h2-vs-atlas.html): Unitree sells the full-size H2 humanoid for $29,900 while Boston Dynamics' Atlas is not for sale and industry estimates put it near $420,000 — a 14x price gap. Full specs, the hardware difference, and buyer guidance.
- [Hesai vs Velodyne: China's $500 Lidar vs America's $75K Pioneer](https://www.robotichina.com/hesai-vs-velodyne.html): Velodyne's HDL-64E cost $75,000 in 2017; Hesai ships automotive long-range lidar for under $500 and owns 43% of the market (Yole). The 99.5% cost collapse, the FMC500 SoC, and what happened to the American pioneer.
- [China's Harmonic Reducers vs Harmonic Drive: 58% to 10%](https://www.robotichina.com/china-harmonic-reducers-vs-harmonic-drive.html): Japan's Harmonic Drive holds ~58% of global harmonic reducer revenue; China's Leaderdrive (Green Harmonic, 688017.SH) is No.2 globally, No.1 in China with 27.5% of units and 80-90% of Chinese humanoids. Pricing, technology gaps, and the 2030 endgame.

- [UBTECH UWORLD U1 vs Tesla Optimus: 13,361 Orders Start Shipping Today](https://www.robotichina.com/ubtech-uworld-u1-vs-optimus.html): The first mass-market companion humanoid starts shipping Sep 16 2026 — 88 DoF, RMB 119,800-990,000, 13,361 pre-orders — compared with Tesla Optimus, and the delivery test ahead.
- [Chinese RV Reducers vs Nabtesco: How 24.98% Is Cracking a 60% Monopoly](https://www.robotichina.com/china-rv-reducers-vs-nabtesco.html): Nabtesco holds ~60% of global RV reducers; Shuanghuan reached 24.98% domestic share, ships lightweight RV into Tesla Optimus' waist at RMB 2,950 average price.
- [China's Six-Axis Force Sensors vs ATI: 80.3% Share and a ¥50,000 Price Gap](https://www.robotichina.com/china-six-axis-force-sensors-vs-ati.html): ATI owned the robot industry's sense of touch for 30 years; in 2025 Chinese suppliers took 92.8% of China's humanoid F/T sensor market (Bluetech 80.3%) at a third of ATI's price.
- [Chinese Planetary Roller Screws vs GSA & Rollvis: The 80% Import Gap Inside Every Humanoid Leg](https://www.robotichina.com/china-planetary-roller-screws-vs-gsa-rollvis.html): GSA and Rollvis hold >50% of the world's roller screws; China imports 80-85% but prices fell from ¥10,000 to ¥2,000 as Shuanglin, NOUS ROBOT and Beite scale production.
